hooks.command: if [ -f tsconfig.json ]; then npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -30; fi

file=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path') or d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$file" ] && [ -f "$file" ]; then if command -v prettier >/dev/null 2>&1; then prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; elif [ -f node_modules/.bin/prettier ]; then node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi

file=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path') or d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$file" ] && [ -f "$file" ]; then if [ -f node_modules/.bin/eslint ]; then node_modules/.bin/eslint "$file" --max-warnings 0 2>&1 | head -20 || true; elif command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && (ls eslint.config.* .eslintrc* 2>/dev/null | grep -q .); then npx eslint "$file" --max-warnings 0 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi; fi

cmd=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q '^git push'; then if [ -f tsconfig.json ]; then echo 'Pre-push: TypeScript check...' && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 || exit 2; fi; if ls eslint.config.* .eslintrc.* 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -q .; then echo 'Pre-push: ESLint check...' && npx eslint . --max-warnings 0 2>&1 | head -20 || exit 2; fi; fi
